descriptionChirho: To be old or to grow old — a stative verb describing the state or process of aging, used of patriarchs, kings, and other persons becoming aged (Gen 18:12-13; 24:1; 27:1-2; Josh 13:1; 23:1-2; Ruth 1:12; 1 Sam 2:22; 4:18; 8:1,5; 12:2; 17:12; 2 Sam 19:32; 1 Kgs 1:1,15; 2 Kgs 4:14; 1 Chr 23:1; 2 Chr 24:15; Job 14:8; Ps 37:25; Prov 22:6; 23:22)
